heroHeadline: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Flores Island, Indonesia
heroSubtitle: BNPB raised the confirmed death toll to 136 on 10 September (48 direct, 88 indirect) with 1,762 injured, while displacement continued its steep decline to 60,572 — down from 70,382 on 8 September — as verified light/moderate-damage households return home. Home-damage verification accelerated sharply to 70% of the 102,384 identified damaged units, up from 50.39% on 7 September, with BNPB's Berton SP Panjaitan targeting completion the following week to unlock reconstruction-aid disbursement. Cumulative aid distribution reached 2,178 tons via the Labuan Bajo and Maumere entry points as the response continues its shift into the rehabilitation-reconstruction phase.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
